sloka: ततः क्रोधमयं तोयं तेजोबलसमन्वितम् ।व्यसर्जयत धर्मात्मा ततः पादौ सिषेच च ।। ७.६५.३१ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ krodhamayaṁ toyaṁ tejobalasamanvitam ।vyasarjayata dharmātmā tataḥ pādau siṣeca ca ।। 7.65.31 ॥

translations.english: Then, the righteous king, releasing the water imbued with anger, power, and strength, poured it onto his own feet.
